name: Joey Zhu
biography: is a staff engineer at Trend Micro Inc. He joined Trend Micro's CoreTech team in 2005. He is highly experienced on threat knowledge and developed the sandbox for TrendLab when working as an expert at PH in 2007. Since 2008, he has been the leader of the ScriptAnalyzer project, which is analyzing HTML/Script to clean up web threats for browsers. Now he is also focusing on anti-phishing solutions.
